info.title: Setu API
info.description: Control-plane REST API for single-binary web apps

get.summary:
The next undelivered command for this server (200), or 204 when none
arrives within the wait window. Delivery marks the command delivered
and counts the attempt; agents are idempotent, so the control plane
may redeliver after `requeue_stale`. Polled per server at 600/min
(spec §7); past that the poll is 429.

204.description: No command within the wait window

post.summary:
Report a command result; unblocks the `DbAgentClient::call` waiting on
it. Scoped to the authed server: a command owned by another server is
404, so agents cannot complete each other's commands. Unknown ids are
404; a body id that disagrees with the path is a 400 (the path is
authoritative). Repeat posts are an ok idempotent no-op (first writer
wins, no overwrite — see `complete_for`).

Heartbeat: marks the server `online` and stores the metrics batch
(the repo upserts both atomically).

Redeem a single-use join token (`JoinRequest` → `JoinResponse`). A
spent, unknown or expired token is 401 from the repo; the join marks
the server `online`.
Publish a version from pasted TOML or a URL (operator and above).

Validate pasted TOML without storing it (operator and above). Always
200: validity is in the body (`ok` + `errors`).

get.summary: One app's versions, newest first (viewer and above).

post.summary:
Log in: verify the argon2id hash, rotate the session id (fixation
guard), store the operator id, and return the operator. Failures count
per source IP: 10 within 15 minutes → 429 on subsequent attempts.

get.summary: The current operator, or 401 when anonymous.

post.summary:
Create an operator (owner only). The password is hashed with argon2id
before storage and never logged.
Register a pending server and mint its join token (operator and above).

delete.summary: Delete a server (operator and above); 409 while sites reference it.

get.summary: Liveness: always 200, no auth, no database.

CommandEnvelope.description:
A command in flight: stable `id` so redelivery is idempotent.
`attempts` counts deliveries (`next_for` bumps it; `requeue_stale`
only resets `delivered_at`), so the agent can tell a retry apart.

CommandResult.description: The agent's report for one command id.

install_command.description: One-line installer using the single binary.

join_token.description: Single-use join token (valid 1 hour); shown once.

EnvVar.description: One concrete env var to write into the site env file.

JoinRequest.description: First contact: the agent redeems a single-use join token.

JoinResponse.description: Control-plane answer to a join: the long-lived server identity.

Limits.description:
Resource limits for one site (mirrors the manifest `limits.default`;
kept local so the agent needs no manifest dependency).

toml.description: Pasted manifest TOML. Exactly one of `toml` / `url` is required.

url.description: URL to fetch the manifest from (public hosts only).

status.description:
Effective status: `pending` until first join, then `online` while
`last_seen_at` is within 60 s, else `offline` (computed at read
time, spec §3/Task 8).

SiteSpec.description: Everything the agent needs to materialise one site.

UnitState.description: One systemd unit's state as observed by the agent.
